events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. The new CRM added +1 to all phone numbers; 31 migrated overseas customers now have incorrect numbers, and batches 4–10 will encounter the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; it is unknown whether they saw or used affected numbers. Recommend warning the sales team, determining the correct country codes, correcting the 31 records, and fixing the migration before continuing. Please confirm how you want to proceed.
